about: r86 v4.4: 60 everyday first lines written for the v4.4 pass, aimed at the blind-set-5 break shapes: ellipses mid-sentence and as a beat, em-dashes (asides, a dash before the point, a cut run-up before a dash), "and/so/but" next to commas around an aside (to be honest, honestly, if I'm honest, ngl, tbh, frankly), trailing tags (just saying, imo, but that's just me, fight me, change my mind) and lowercase run-ons. sharpen-v44.test.mjs holds every version the engine returns on them, in every mode, to the hard guards, the page guard and its own break checks.
